correctness.rationale: An independent complete enumeration of 196,009 augmented faces, 97,999 unit Morse pairs, complete acyclic Hasse topological sort, and exact integer critical differentials establishes Z^7 in degree six. A second signed-face computation checks the fixed-orbit Lefschetz method for every element order. All 336 automorphisms are enumerated and an exact sum of character squares is 336; restriction to the 168 Fano collineations gives square-sum 168. All assertions were executed using the enclosed standalone checker.

value.rationale: A complete seven-dimensional irreducible PGL(2,7) representation on a natural graph complex with 336 symmetries is a structural topological invariant beyond the known seven-sphere Betti count. It distinguishes the two seven-dimensional irreducible extensions, proves irreducibility even under PSL(2,7), and detects vanishing invariants. The exceptional Coxeter/Fano geometry motivates this precise value; no general theorem or integral lattice classification is invented.
